title: Weekly focus hours
description: Outlined blue tiles show intensity on a fixed scale. Dots distinguish measured zero from unavailable cells marked with a cross.

props.name: data
props.description: Readings keyed by rowId and columnId, with nonnegative finite value or null. Omitted pairs are unavailable. Values above maxValue are unavailable rather than clamped. Duplicate pairs and undeclared axis IDs show an explicit invalid state.

props.name: rows
props.description: Ordered rows with unique nonempty id and display label.

props.name: columns
props.description: Ordered columns with unique nonempty id and display label.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Required finite positive intensity ceiling. This scale remains fixed as data changes.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned measurement or allocation label. Defaults to Value, or Share for Hundred Blocks.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional reporting period or other caller-owned context.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats direct labels and tooltips; defaults to en-US numbers with up to two decimal places. Cartesian ticks use numeric notation.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels; otherwise content determines height. Dense plots scroll locally.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable finite native Recharts motion subject to the language tokens and reduced motion.
